label: Finite actual panels and one finite pivot yield one maximal direct giver of esse (inference)
rule: Apply the registered finite-hitting law to panel unions and take singleton panels
meaning: Use the one-finite-population projection of the checked #561 package. Finite recipient panels index the universal component and actual maximal givers form its fixed roster. Union gives a subintersection of the two passing populations. Every-panel coverage supplies population and the pivot supplies finiteness; the resulting fixed candidate passes every singleton in the original actual dictionary. Equality exempts the giver and all distinct actual recipients have direct esse edges.
